name: Max and Molly
source:
College student Molly works part time in her mother's bakery outlet. Her social life is non-existent, until Max walks into the store.

[From [url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=2274]Wolflore[/url]]
translation:
大学生莫莉在她母亲的面包店兼职。在麦克斯走进商店之前，她的社交生活根本就不存在。

[来自[url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=2274]Wolflore[/url]]
